title: Polymer Billing
summary: GST billing, dues and ledgers for a plastics manufacturer, built on the Eclipse base.
problem: The factory billed by hand. Every invoice needed weights, box sizes, GST and a vehicle number, plus separate copies for the buyer and the transporter, and the running balance for each buyer had to be worked out separately.
solution: Adapted the proven Eclipse invoice platform to the factory's rules: weight-based lines, CGST/SGST or IGST by buyer, vehicle number on every invoice and print-ready copies, with payments and ledgers so dues stay current.

features.title: GST invoices
features.description: CGST + SGST for local buyers and IGST for other states, with HSN codes and round-off.

features.title: Weight and pack sizes
features.description: Lines by product, size and pack, with weight in kg on the print.

features.title: Transport-ready prints
features.description: Vehicle number on the invoice and separate copies for buyer and transporter.

features.title: Payments and ledgers
features.description: Cash entries update each buyer's outstanding; ledgers and reports print on demand.

features.title: Dashboard
features.description: Sales, collections and outstanding at a glance.

features.title: Daily backup
features.description: The database is backed up and emailed every day.

aiNote: AI helped map the differences between the two businesses and adapt the shared code safely. Screens shown are illustrative mock-ups with sample data; the live system is private to the client.
